# Supplementary material {background-color='{{< brand color blue >}}' .bkg-ship visibility="uncounted"}

## Working with pipes in {survey} {.bkg-mountains visibility="uncounted"}

:::::{.columns}
::::{.column width=42%}

Magrittr pipe (`%>%`)

- dot notation

```r
design_object %>% 
  svyglm(design = ., y ~ x)
```

::::

::::{.column}
Base R pipe (`|>`)

- placeholder
    
```r
design_object |> 
  svyglm(design = _, y ~ x)
```
- anonymous (lambda) functions

```r
design_object |> 
  (\(.) 
   svyglm(design = ., y ~ x)
  )()
```

::::
:::::
